purpose: Strongly reject a possibility as impossible or unreasonable.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain form + わけがない; noun / な-adjective + な + わけがない
There is no way we can get in without a key.
There is no way he would forget the promise.
There is no way I can memorize all of it in one day.
formation: Plain form + わけがない; noun / な-adjective + な + わけがない
restrictions: Expresses the speaker’s strong judgment, often based on what they know.
mistake: It is stronger than かもしれない in the negative; use carefully when evidence is limited.
